headline: Kenya Targets Double-Digit Growth as Economy Expands at 5 Percent
summary: Kenya is laying foundations for double-digit economic growth, supported by improved macroeconomic stability and rising investor confidence while maintaining a 5% expansion.
why: Tracking emerging market growth trajectories helps investors assess sovereign risk, debt sustainability, and regional investment opportunities in East Africa.

impacts.name: Kenya
impacts.why: Improved macroeconomic indicators and growth projections signal positive sovereign economic health.
